items.title: The Hodge cohomology of projective space is one-dimensional on the diagonal, generated by powers of the first Chern class
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the Hodge cohomology of projective space: it vanishes off the diagonal and is free of rank one on it, generated by the powers of the first Chern class of the twisting sheaf (statement lines 1704-1710). The proof takes the vanishing and rank statement from the twisted computation, settles the case $p = 0$ directly, identifies the generator for $p = 1$ by writing the boundary of the section $1$ as the logarithmic derivative cocycle and comparing with the cocycle of $\mathcal{O}(1)$, and then runs an induction in which the boundary of the lifted cocycle is computed explicitly. The explicit cocycle computation is the substance, so the claim is H2.
